scripts.text:
[William]
Welcome to
MacMillan's ^3355FFPost^000000 Workshop.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
歡迎光臨
麥克米蘭^3355FF郵政^000000工坊。

scripts.text:
[William]
My family, the MacMillan Clan, has been producing Professional Traffic Signal Posts for more than 250 years. Nowadays, we are booking Special Orders for our unique ornament, ^3355FFStop Post^000000.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
我的家族，麥克米蘭一族，已經生產專業交通訊號燈柱超過250年了。如今，我們正在接受我們獨特飾品的特別訂單，^3355FF停止標誌頭飾^000000。

scripts.text: Could I order one ^3355FFStop Post^000000?
scripts.translation: 我可以訂購一個^3355FF停止標誌頭飾^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Nah...
scripts.translation: 不了...

scripts.text:
[William]
This unique ornament, ^3355FFStop Post^000000, is a traffic signal on the road, and doubles as a hair ornament! This, we solemnly promise on the strength of a 100-year guarantee.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
這款獨特的飾品，^3355FF停止標誌頭飾^000000，既是路上的交通訊號燈，又是一款髮飾！我們鄭重承諾，提供100年保修。

scripts.text:
[William]
To produce a ^3355FFStop Post^000000, we need ^3355FF91100 Zeny^000000, ^3355FF50 Trunk^000000 and ^3355FF1 Black Dyestuffs^000000.

[William]
Here you are~!
This ^3355FFStop Post^000000 has
been especially made
just for you!
Thank you for stopping by!
...Get the joke?
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
給您~！
這個^3355FF停止標誌頭飾^000000
是專門為您
特別製作的！
感謝您的光臨！
...懂這個梗嗎？

scripts.text:
[William]
So...
When you get those items, swing on by and we'll give you a Stop Post.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
那麼...
當您準備好那些材料後，隨時過來，我們會給您一個停止標誌頭飾。

scripts.text:
[William]
Anyway, thank you for coming by 'MacMillan's Workshop.' But think about buying something next time, will ya?
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
總之，感謝您光臨“麥克米蘭工坊”。不過下次請考慮買點什麼，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Howdy, new customer!!
I know what you're gonna talk about. You want the Magic Glasses from me, riiiiight?
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
嘿，新顧客！！
我知道你要說什麼。你是想從我這裡買魔法眼鏡，對吧？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text: Manufacture
scripts.translation: 製造

scripts.text: Ignore him
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Hmm~!
Well, the official name for them is ^3355FFBinoculars^000000! An optical device that works like a pair of field glasses, they're designed for simultaneous use by both eyes!
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
嗯~！
它們的正式名稱是^3355FF望遠鏡^000000！這是一種像雙筒望遠鏡一樣的光學裝置，設計用於雙眼同時使用！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
They're made up of two small telescopes joined with a single focusing device. You can arrange the lenses to produce stereoscopic vision.
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
它由兩個小望遠鏡和一個單一的調焦裝置組成。你可以調整鏡片以產生立體視覺。

scripts.text:
[Marius]
So?
Ain't that
something, huh?
Muhahahahahaha!
. . . . .
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
怎麼樣？
是不是很
厲害，對吧？
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
. . . . .

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Hm? You don't seem to
believe what I just said?
Oh c'mon, jerk. It's real!!
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
嗯？你似乎
不相信我剛才說的話？
拜託，混蛋。這是真的！！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
I will let you
know the items I need...
1 ^3355FFGeek Glasses^000000! 100 ^3355FFSteel^000000!
And ^3355FF50000 Zeny^000000!

[Marius]
Perfect, perfect !
Now my masterpiece will be complete!
Muhahahaha !
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
完美，完美！
現在我的傑作就要完成了！
穆哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Here you are!
Binoculars !
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
給您！
望遠鏡！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Just remember...
Don't peep at something you shouldn't look at. Well, at least try not to.
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
記住...
不要窺視你不該看的東西。好吧，至少試著別這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Argggghhhhhhh!!
You didn't bring
enough items!!!!
How dare you
disgrace me!!!
Baaaadddd !!
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
阿格格格格格！！
你帶來的材料
不夠！！！！
你竟敢
讓我丟臉！！！
壞蛋！！！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Hey you~!
Now you're in front of Marius, an Alchemist among Alchemists. Ignoring me, eh? Come on, I'll beat your ass!
scripts.translation:
[馬裡烏斯]
嘿，你~！
現在你站在馬裡烏斯面前了，我可是鍊金術士中的鍊金術士。無視我，是吧？來吧，我要揍扁你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but may I ask
you a question?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，請問可以問你一個問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Eh? Oh, I'm sorry, I was
so busy reading this book!
So, uh, what exactly did
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
啊？哦，對不起，我剛才
太專心看這本書了！
那麼，呃，你具體想問什麼？

scripts.text: What are you reading?
scripts.translation: 你在看什麼書？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Ah! This is one of the best sellers of Joshua Vansei's.
The main character is a writer, and it's so touching that this guy writes a story of his mistress...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
啊！這是約書亞·範賽的最新暢銷書之一。
主角是個作家，故事非常感人，他寫了自己與蜂后的故事...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh.. I can't wait to see Hoein Special..
And this, you could have a look if you want to.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮婭]
哦...我迫不及待想看看《赫因特輯》了。
還有這本，如果你感興趣的話可以看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, now, I shouldn't.
Looks like the cover's rounded with a red strap,
which..I really think is for adults only.
ex..cuse me~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，現在，我不該看的。
看起來封面是用紅色絲帶綁著的，這...我覺得那是成人專用的。
對...對不起~！

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
I've always believed in Satan..
Haah... Guess it's good to be living, after all.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
我一直相信魔王...
唉...看來活著還是好的。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Who would've thought to actually see the Satan while alive.....?
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
誰能想到在活著的時候真的看到了魔王呢.....？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh, the world.. the world is doomed..
-sobbing-
Nothing seems to be working now..
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦，世界...世界要毀滅了..
-哭泣-
現在似乎什麼都行不通了..

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....Tsk..tsk...
Good heavens.. I can't believe this young girl's drinking with sadness....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
....嘖..嘖...
天哪..我簡直不敢相信這個年輕女孩在悲傷中喝酒....

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
No commoners are allowed in the area beyond this point.
This place is extremely dangerous so you are restricted from entering.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
平民不得進入此區域。
這裡極其危險，因此禁止進入。

scripts.text: Cancel Conversation
scripts.translation: 取消對話

scripts.text: Ask What Happened
scripts.translation: 詢問發生了什麼

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Didn't you know? Satan Morocc has resurrected and broke out of Morocc Village where he was confined.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
你不知道嗎？魔王夢羅克復活了，並打破了將他囚禁的夢羅克村莊。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
His resurrection has caused irreparable damage to the village and to the desert around it, and now he has moved to the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
他的復活給村莊和周圍的沙漠造成了無法彌補的破壞，現在他已轉移到蘇克拉特沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
We are here to carry out the orders of the Prontera Kingdom by preventing commoners, aside from the members of the Morocc Subjugation, from accessing the area.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
我們在此執行普隆德拉王國的命令，阻止平民（夢羅克鎮壓小組成員除外）進入該區域。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
If you'd like to know more information, I suggest that you speak to the Continental Guard in charge of the accident site in Morocc Village.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
如果您想了解更多資訊，建議您與負責夢羅克村莊事故現場的大陸衛兵對話。

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Ask About Guard's Location
scripts.translation: 詢問衛兵的位置

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
The guard that you want to talk to is at a camp built in the center of Morocc Village.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
您想交談的衛兵在夢羅克村莊中心搭建的營地。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
If you'd like, I can send you there directly.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
如果您願意，我可以直接送您去那裡。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Please do.
scripts.translation: 請這樣做。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
I see. Well then, for your safety, please leave this dangerous area as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
明白了。那麼，為了您的安全，請儘快離開這個危險區域。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Great. I'll send you to Morocc Village's accident site shortly.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
好的。我馬上送您去夢羅克村莊的事故現場。

scripts.text: Move to Morocc's Accident Site

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

是的，我已確認您是大陸衛隊的成員。祝您任務順利。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
I'll send you to the field shortly. Please use the warp at the field entrance to come back to this area.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Welcome, members of the Continental Guards. I have a special order from Chief Balrog for you, so let me read it for you.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
歡迎，大陸衛隊的成員們。我有一封來自首領巴洛格的特別命令，讓我為您宣讀一下。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
'Due to the dangers of this area, I hereby prohibit members of the Continental Guard to investigate the area alone. You must organize a party of at least 2 members to carry out your missions from now on.'
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
“鑑於該區域的危險性，我在此禁止大陸衛隊成員單獨調查該區域。從現在起，你們必須組建至少2名成員的隊伍來執行任務。”

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
...You understand that, right? Please go back to the site, and come back in a party of at least 2 members. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
......您明白了嗎？請返回現場，並組建至少2名成員的隊伍再來。謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Only members of the Continental Guards with Continental Guard Certificates are allowed to proceed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
只有持有大陸衛隊證書的大陸衛隊成員才能通過此處。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
We've received orders from Headquarters to block access to this area since an unusual space-time phenomenon has been detected from the Morocc field.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
我們收到總部的命令，由於在夢羅克野外檢測到異常時空現象，封鎖了該區域的入口。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
We need to wait until the phenomenon is over, and then we'll let you proceed with your investigation.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
我們需要等待現象結束，然後才會允許您繼續調查。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Great. I'll send you to Morocc Village's accident site shortly.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
好的。我馬上送您去夢羅克村莊的事故現場。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Ah, you're an adventurer working for the Continental Guard. Nice to meet you. Feel free to ask me if you need my assistance.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛兵]
啊，您是受僱於大陸衛隊的冒險者。很高興見到您。如果您需要幫助，請隨時問我。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Good day, {0}. We don't have the luxury of time in this dire situation so I'll try to make this quick.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
您好，{0}。在這種危急情況下，我們沒有太多時間，所以我儘量長話短說。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
I'm a messenger dispatched here to {0} from the Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters. My duty is to deliver this important message to as many renowned adventurers as I can. I'm glad that I was finally able to find you, {1}.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
我是從夢羅克大陸衛隊總部派往{0}的信使。我的職責是將這份重要訊息傳達給儘可能多的知名冒險者。很高興我終於找到了您，{1}。

scripts.text: Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters?
scripts.translation: 夢羅克大陸衛隊總部？

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Time's running out, so I can only give you a brief explanation.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
時間緊迫，我只能簡單說明一下情況。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Satan Morocc, the heinous demon imprisoned deep in Morocc's underground for centuries, has resurrected and broken free.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
被囚禁在夢羅克地下深處的魔王夢羅克，已經復活並掙脫了封印。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The revival of Satan Morocc has completely devastated Morocc Village and the area surrounding it.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
魔王夢羅克的復活，徹底摧毀了夢羅克村莊及其周邊地區。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
All of the death and suffering... Anywhere else must seem like heaven compared to what's happening in and around Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
死亡與痛苦蔓延...與夢羅克發生的一切相比，其他地方簡直如同天堂。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The Morocc Continental Guard was immediately organized to fight Satan Morocc and bring relief to this dire situation. I'm here to inform everyone in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom about this catastrophe.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
夢羅克大陸衛隊已迅速組建，以對抗魔王夢羅克並緩解這一危急局勢。我在此是為了向盧恩·米德加茲王國的所有人通報這場災難。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
We need your help, {0}. We need reputable adventurers like you to seal away Satan Morocc once again.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
我們需要您的幫助，{0}。我們需要像您這樣聲譽卓著的冒險者，再次將魔王夢羅克封印起來。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
For more information, please speak to the captain of the Morocc Continental Guard. He is waiting for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
如需瞭解更多詳情，請與夢羅克大陸衛隊的船長對話。他正在等您，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The Continental Guard Headquarters is located near the center palace of Morocc, so please go speak to the chief as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
大陸衛隊總部位於夢羅克中央宮殿附近，請儘快去與首領對話。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
I'm a messenger from the Morocc Continental Guards Headquarters, and I've come here to {0} with an urgent message for everyone here in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
我是夢羅克大陸衛隊總部的信使，我帶著緊急訊息來到{0}，要傳達給盧恩·米德加茲王國的所有人。

scripts.text: Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters?
scripts.translation: 夢羅克大陸衛隊總部？

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Time's running out, so I can only give you a brief explanation.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
時間緊迫，我只能簡單說明一下情況。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Satan Morocc, the heinous demon imprisoned deep in Morocc's underground for centuries, has resurrected and broken free.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
被囚禁在夢羅克地下深處的魔王夢羅克，已經復活並掙脫了封印。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The revival of Satan Morocc has completely devastated Morocc Village and the area surrounding it.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
魔王夢羅克的復活，徹底摧毀了夢羅克村莊及其周邊地區。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
All of the death and suffering... Anywhere else must seem like heaven compared to what's happening in and around Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
死亡與痛苦蔓延...與夢羅克發生的一切相比，其他地方簡直如同天堂。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The Morocc Continental Guard was immediately organized to fight Satan Morocc and bring relief to this dire situation. I'm here to inform everyone in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom about this catastrophe.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
夢羅克大陸衛隊已迅速組建，以對抗魔王夢羅克並緩解這一危急局勢。我在此是為了向盧恩·米德加茲王國的所有人通報這場災難。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Part of my duty is to help recruit adventurers from around the world to help drive Satan Morocc back into confinement. It won't be easy, but he was defeated once before. Satan Morocc can be sealed away again.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
我的職責之一是招募世界各地的冒險者，協助將魔王夢羅克重新封印。這並不容易，但他曾被擊敗過。魔王夢羅克是可以再次被封印的。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
At least 70% of Morocc Village was destroyed by the fallout of Satan Morocc's resurrection.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
夢羅克村莊至少有70%的區域因魔王夢羅克的復活而遭到破壞。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The desert around Morocc has also turned into a land of death after it was claimed by Satan Morocc and his powerful doppelgangers and underlings.
So heed my warning, stay away from the Morocc area unless you're on a mission organized by the Morocc Continental Guard.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
夢羅克周邊的沙漠也因魔王夢羅克及其強大的分身和手下而變成了死亡之地。
因此請聽從我的警告，除非是執行夢羅克大陸衛隊組織的任務，否則請遠離夢羅克地區。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Are you... {0}?
Ah, very well. I have an extremely important message for you.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
您是...{0}？
啊，很好。我有一條極其重要的訊息要告訴您。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The situation is urgent, so please listen to me carefully.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊信使]
情況緊急，請仔細聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
On behalf of the Continental Guard, I thank you for your efforts. Now, let me see if I've received any news from Headquarters that you should know...
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
代表大陸衛隊，感謝您的付出。現在，讓我看看是否收到了您應該知道的總部訊息...

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Nothing yet. Please carry on with your current mission. Once again, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
還沒有訊息。請繼續執行您當前的任務。再次感謝您。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Welcome to the Morocc Subjugation Information Center. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
歡迎來到夢羅克討伐資訊中心。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: What is this place for?
scripts.translation: 這是什麼地方？

scripts.text: I'm here to volunteer.
scripts.translation: 我要報名志願軍。

scripts.text: Tell me about the village situation.
scripts.translation: 告訴我村莊的情況。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I'm stationed here to assist adventurers who wish to volunteer and help the Continental Guard fight Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
我駐守在此，協助那些希望志願加入大陸衛隊，共同對抗魔王夢羅克的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I am sure you are already aware that Satan Morocc's revival threatens the peace of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom, and if Satan Morocc is allowed to roam free, it will devour the entire world.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
我想您應該已經知道，魔王夢羅克的復活威脅著盧恩·米德加茲王國的和平。如果任由魔王夢羅克肆虐，它將吞噬整個世界。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
The Continental Guard is currently planning an array of countermeasures to suppress Satan Morocc under the order of the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
大陸衛隊目前正在王國的命令下，制定一系列對策以鎮壓魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
If you have been invited by our messenger, or are confident in your skills, we encourage you to volunteer for the Continental Guards and bring peace back to this continent.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
如果您收到了我們信使的邀請，或者對自己的實力有信心，我們鼓勵您志願加入大陸衛隊，為這片大陸帶來和平。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Welcome, {0}. I've been waiting for you. I assume our messenger informed you of our situation.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
歡迎，{0}。我一直在等您。我想我們的信使已經向您說明了當前的情況。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Let me process your application immediately. Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
讓我立即為您辦理申請手續。請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Now please go speak to Chief Balrog of the Continental Guard. You can find him in the center.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
現在請去與大陸衛隊的首領 巴洛格對話。您可以在中央找到他。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I applaud you for your courage, but you will need more than just courage to help us.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
我欽佩您的勇氣，但僅憑勇氣還不足以幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Satan Morocc is most powerful evil that exists in the mortal world. Snuffing out your life would be so trivial to him.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
魔王夢羅克是凡間最強大的邪惡存在。對您而言，結束您的生命對他來說不過是舉手之勞。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I strongly recommend that you just think about your own safety for now. When the final battle comes, I am sure that no place will be safe.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
我強烈建議您現在先考慮自己的安全。當最終決戰來臨時，我相信沒有任何地方是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
As you can see, the situation can't be worse. The village and the surrounding area were irreparably damaged by Satan Morocc's resurrection.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
如您所見，情況已經糟糕透頂。村莊及周邊地區因魔王夢羅克的復活而遭受了無法修復的破壞。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Since the kingdom has dispatched Continental Guard Messengers everywhere, many able adventurers have flocked to this place, but... I'm afraid they still might not be enough to defeat the demon.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
由於王國已向各地派遣了大陸衛隊信使，許多有能力的冒險者都聚集到了這裡，但...恐怕這仍然不足以擊敗惡魔。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Please follow our instructions, at least around this area, and stay out of danger for now.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
請遵循我們的指示，至少在這個區域內，暫時遠離危險。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Your application already has been registered. Please go speak to Chief Balrog.
scripts.translation:
[大陸衛隊官員]
您的申請已經登記完畢。請去與首領 巴洛格對話。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morocc in order to suppress Satan Morocc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
您來得不是時候，但很高興見到您。我是大陸衛隊的首領 巴洛格。我們被派往夢羅克以鎮壓魔王夢羅克...我們需要聚集所有能找到的力量和運氣。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm sorry, but I'm too busy checking through all these applications for future Continental Guards to greet you adventurers one by one.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
抱歉，我正忙著稽核這些未來大陸衛隊的申請，沒空逐一問候各位冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Listen, it might be more helpful if you talk to some other people first. I'm sure one of the other Continental Guards or our messengers will be better equipped to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
聽著，也許先和其他人聊聊會更有幫助。我相信其他大陸衛隊成員或我們的信使能更好地為您提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morocc in order to suppress Satan Morocc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
您來得不是時候，但很高興見到您。我是大陸衛隊的首領 巴洛格。我們被派往夢羅克以鎮壓魔王夢羅克...我們需要聚集所有能找到的力量和運氣。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
It looks like you have business with me. Please make it brief since I don't have a lot of time on my hands. There's lots of things I need to take care of...
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
看來您有正事找我。請長話短說，因為我手頭有很多事情要處理，時間很緊...

scripts.text: Ask about Continental Guards
scripts.translation: 詢問關於大陸衛隊的事

scripts.text: I want to join the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation: 我想加入大陸衛隊

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The damage that Satan Morocc's resurrection has caused is obvious just by taking a look around this area.
What's scary is that all this was caused just by breaking out from it's prison. Just think of the damage it could do if it was left to roam around freely...
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
魔王夢羅克復活所造成的破壞，只要看看周圍的環境就一目瞭然。
可怕的是，這一切僅僅是因為它掙脫了牢籠。想像一下，如果它被放任自由地四處遊蕩，會造成多大的破壞...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Morocc Village is completely devastated, and Satan Morocc has now claimed possession of the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
夢羅克村莊已經徹底被毀，而魔王夢羅克現在佔據了蘇克拉特沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I've no doubt that if left unchecked, Satan Morocc will take over the entire Midgard Continent. We've got to stop him right now before the entire world suffers.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
毫無疑問，如果不加阻止，魔王夢羅克將佔領整個米德加爾特大陸。我們必須在它給整個世界帶來災難之前，立刻阻止它。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
That's why the kingdom has ordered us elite soldiers to form the Continental Guard, and recruit reputable adventurers around the world so that we can make a united stand against Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
因此，王國命令我們精英士兵組建大陸衛隊，並招募世界各地的知名冒險者，以便我們聯合起來對抗魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Of course, it'll be incredibly difficult... We'll need to make sacrifices... I'm not even sure if we can win. Still, the fate of the world is at stake, and we've got to do something. Dark times have truly fallen upon us...
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
當然，這將極其困難...我們將不得不做出犧牲...我甚至不確定我們能否獲勝。儘管如此，世界的命運懸於一線，我們必須採取行動。黑暗的時代真的降臨了...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Huh? Do you want to join us and volunteer for the Continental Guard?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
咦？你想加入我們，自願成為大陸衛隊的一員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
What was your name? {0}? Oh yes, I've heard of you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
你叫什麼名字？{0}？哦，是的，我聽說過你。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Hmm, it occurs to me that you don't understand the danger involved in all this. Do you have any idea how powerful Satan Morocc is?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
嗯，我突然想到，你可能並不瞭解其中蘊含的危險。你知道魔王夢羅克有多強大嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You won't be able to help us if you don't fully understand the risks. I've seen thousands of foolhardy adventurers throw their lives away by thinking they could defeat Satan Morocc with their own strength.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
如果你不完全瞭解風險，就無法幫助我們。我見過成千上萬魯莽的冒險者，自以為憑一己之力就能擊敗魔王夢羅克，結果白白送命。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
We are facing a threat that will determine the world's future, and fools that can't work in a team will be liabilities, not assets.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我們面對的是決定世界未來的威脅，那些無法團隊協作的傻瓜只會成為累贅，而不是助力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm sorry, but inexperienced adventurers would just get in our way. I hope you understand. If you really want to help us, then please focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
很抱歉，經驗不足的冒險者只會妨礙我們。希望你能理解。如果你真的想幫助我們，那麼請暫時專注於提升自己的實力。

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Ask Again
scripts.translation: 再問一次

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Look, I understand your enthusiasm, but you're mistaken if you think you can help us. I don't have time to fully explain the danger that we're all facing.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
聽著，我理解你的熱情，但如果你認為你能幫上忙，那就大錯特錯了。我沒有時間詳細解釋我們所有人面臨的危險。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Satan Morocc is nothing like the monsters you may have encountered. At best you'll throw your life away, but there's the chance that you might get one of my men killed by your mistakes and incompetence. I can't have that!
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
魔王夢羅克與你可能遇到的魔物完全不同。最好的情況是你白白送命，但更糟糕的是，你的失誤和無能可能會導致我的部下喪命。我不能讓這種事發生！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Please understand that this is for your own good. Fight some Porings or whatever else might be a good match for your level.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
請理解，這是為你好。去和波利或其他適合你等級的魔物戰鬥吧。

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: You've just got to let me join!
scripts.translation: 你就讓我加入吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Sigh... Why are you so persistent? Can't you understand that no means no? Let me say this one more time.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
唉...你為什麼這麼執著？難道不明白“不”就是“不”嗎？讓我再說最後一次。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
We're too busy fighting Satan Morocc to watch after rookies like you. You'd just be throwing your life away.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我們正忙著對抗魔王夢羅克，沒空照顧像你這樣的新人。你只會白白送命。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Stop bothering me. You'd be nothing but a burden.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
別煩我了。你只會成為累贅。

scripts.text: Give Up
scripts.translation: 放棄

scripts.text: Give me a chance to prove myself!
scripts.translation: 給我一個證明自己的機會！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Huh? You want a chance to prove yourself?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
哈？你想證明自己的實力？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'll do whatever it takes to join the Continental Guard!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，為了加入大陸衛兵，我願意付出任何代價！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Interesting. You have my attention. Alright, I guess it's only fair that I acknowledge your strength if you can handle something for me.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
有意思。你引起了我的注意。好吧，既然你如此堅持，如果你能幫我完成一件事，我就承認你的實力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The Continental Guard has been on full alert around this village and the desert. We need to be prepared in case Satan Morocc storms our defenses.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
大陸衛兵在這個村莊和沙漠周圍處於全面警戒狀態。我們需要做好準備，以防魔王夢羅克突襲我們的防線。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Soldiers need firewood to keep the bonfires burning all night, but we've been suffering a firewood shortage.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
士兵們需要柴火來整夜燃燒篝火，但我們一直面臨柴火短缺的問題。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I happened to hear that the monsters in the Lava Dungeon have everlasting flame which would solve our bonfire problems. I want you to gather those flames for us.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我聽說熔岩副本里的魔物擁有永恆之火，這能解決我們的篝火問題。我要你去為我們收集那些火焰。

scripts.text: That's too hard! Let me think about it!
scripts.translation: 太難了！讓我考慮一下！

scripts.text: No problem.
scripts.translation: 沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Hmpf, I was right. I knew you wouldn't be able to handle such a simple task. I shouldn't have wasted my time with you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
哼，我就知道。我早就知道連這麼簡單的任務你都做不了。我不該在你身上浪費時間。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Excellent! Bring back ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000. I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
很好！帶回來^0000FF30火種^000000。我會在這裡等你回來。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
What? How can you even think of joining us when you don't have any real skills to offer?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
什麼？你沒有任何實際技能，怎麼敢想加入我們？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I guarantee that you'd just drag my soldiers down with you. You'd only be a threat to Satan Morocc in your dreams. Just give it up.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我敢保證，你只會拖累我計程車兵。你只能在夢裡威脅魔王夢羅克。還是放棄吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You won't be able to help us if you don't fully understand the risks. I've seen thousands of foolhardy adventurers throw their lives away by thinking they could defeat Satan Morocc with their own strength.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
如果你不完全瞭解風險，就無法幫助我們。我見過成千上萬魯莽的冒險者，自以為憑一己之力就能擊敗魔王夢羅克，結果白白送命。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
We are facing a threat that will determine the world's future, and fools that can't work in a team will be liabilities, not assets.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我們面對的是決定世界未來的威脅，那些無法團隊協作的傻瓜只會成為累贅，而不是助力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm sorry, but inexperienced adventurers would just get in our way. I hope you understand. If you really want to help us, then please focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
很抱歉，經驗不足的冒險者只會妨礙我們。希望你能理解。如果你真的想幫助我們，那麼請暫時專注於提升自己的實力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
So, did you find ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000? You didn't come empty-handed, did you?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
那麼，你找到^0000FF30火種^000000了嗎？你不會空手而歸吧？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Let's see... One, two, three... Thirty, you've brought them all. Well, this was a pretty simple task. All it takes is time and a little effort. Anyone could do it.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
讓我看看...一，二，三...三十，你都帶回來了。嗯，這確實是個簡單的任務。只需要一點時間和努力。誰都能做到。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Anyways, thank you for bringing the Live Coals. I guess you're stronger than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
總之，謝謝你帶回了火種。看來你比我想像的更強。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now will you let me join the Continental Guard?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在你可以讓我加入大陸衛兵了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
No, gathering these flames is a piece of cake compared to what we're going to do.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
不，收集這些火焰與我們即將要做的事情相比，簡直是小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm still not convinced that you're good enough to join us. Let me think... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我仍然不確信你有足夠的實力加入我們。讓我想想... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't think you would accept me so easily. I'm ready. Ask me whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒想到你會這麼輕易地接受我。我準備好了。儘管問吧，問什麼都行。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Ah, I've got an idea. Now, because this is an allied operation, we've accepted some mercenary soldiers from the Schwarzwald Republic to join the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
啊，我有個主意。既然這是一次聯合行動，我們接納了一些來自修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的傭兵加入大陸衛兵。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
These mercenaries have never seen the desert, and they're having trouble carrying out operations in the heat, dry air, and sandstorms. It's not their fault, but they could use a little help since they're out of their element.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
這些傭兵從未見過沙漠，他們在炎熱、乾燥的空氣和沙塵暴中執行任務時遇到了困難。這不是他們的錯，但他們身處陌生環境，可能需要一點幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(This guy seems threatening, but he seems to have a good heart.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(這傢伙看起來很有威脅性，但他似乎心地善良。)

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Now, I remember hearing that the monsters in the Ice Cave to the north have frozen hearts. Those hearts might be able to relieve those soldiers from the heat.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我記得聽說北邊的冰洞裡的魔物擁有冰封之心。那些心臟或許能緩解那些士兵的炎熱。

scripts.text: That's too hard!
scripts.translation: 太難了！

scripts.text: No problem. How many do you want?
scripts.translation: 沒問題。你要多少？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I knew that'd be too tough for you. I'm glad you finally realized your limits before it was too late. It takes wisdom to recognize your weakness.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我就知道這對你來說太難了。很高興你在為時已晚之前意識到了自己的極限。能認識到自己的弱點是一種智慧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You'd better pack up and return where you came from. You want to be far away from here when Satan Morocc attacks.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
你最好收拾好行囊，回到你來的地方。當魔王夢羅克進攻時，你最好離這裡遠遠的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Huh?! Are you sure you can bring those? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
什麼？！你確定你能帶回來嗎？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Well... If you insist on giving it a try, then... I'll need at least 50 of those frozen hearts.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
好吧... 如果你堅持要試試的話... 我至少需要50個冰封之心。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Please bring me ^0000FF50 Glacial Hearts^000000. The faster you get them here, the better.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
請給我帶^0000FF50冰塊心臟^000000。越快越好。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 30 Live Coals, 30.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
嗯... 你沒聽到我說的話嗎？我說的是30個火種，30個。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
現在快點去吧。如果你想放棄，沒關係。但請告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
So, did you find 50 Glacial Hearts?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
那麼，你找到50個冰塊心臟了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Thank you. I'm sure that my soldiers will appreciate these... Those guys aren't used to the desert, and could use the relief.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
謝謝。我相信我計程車兵們會感激這些... 那些傢伙不習慣沙漠，需要這些來緩解炎熱。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Well... It looks like you earned this.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
嗯... 看來你確實贏得了這個。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You'd know if you read it. It's a certificate that proves that you're a member of the Continental Guard. I admit that I'm impressed by your skills and gumption.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
如果你讀一下就會知道。這是一張證明你是大陸衛兵成員的證書。我承認，你的技能和勇氣讓我印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Welcome to the Continental Guard, my friend. Are you ready to risk your life for the sake of peace in the world?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
歡迎加入大陸衛兵，我的朋友。
你準備好為了世界的和平而獻出生命了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Your mission from here on will be simple, but extremely difficult: you will join the rest of the Continental Guard to keep Satan Morocc from fully reviving its true power.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
從今以後，你的任務很簡單，但極其困難：
你將加入大陸衛兵，阻止魔王夢羅克完全恢復其真正的力量。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
My soldiers are risking their lives to fight Morocc's doppelgangers and underlings in order to make it safer for their comrades to travel to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我計程車兵們正冒著生命危險，
與夢羅克的分身和手下戰鬥，
以便讓他們的同志能更安全地前往夢羅克的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
It looks like your help could be useful after all. It's time for you to pitch in. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
看來你的幫助確實派上用場了。
是時候讓你大顯身手了。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 50 Glacial Hearts, 50.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
嗯... 你沒聽到我說的話嗎？
我說的是50個冰塊心臟，50個。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
現在快點去吧。如果你想放棄，沒關係。但請告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I guess you'd benefit from a full situational briefing. Shall I brief you now?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
看來你需要一份完整的情報簡報。
現在為你簡報嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm going to tell you some basic information about fighting Satan Morocc as a member of the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我將向你介紹作為大陸衛兵成員，
對抗魔王夢羅克的一些基本資訊。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Do you remember what Morocc was like before this happened? You would if you've been here before.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
你還記得事情發生前夢羅克的樣子嗎？
如果你之前來過這裡，應該記得。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Right now, all of Morocc's entrances and the outer fields leading to other villages are currently under our control.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
目前，夢羅克的所有入口以及通往其他村莊的外圍區域，
都在我們的控制之下。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The main reason for this is because Satan Morocc has been sighted in Sograt Desert, but there's another important reason.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
主要原因是魔王夢羅克在蘇克拉特沙漠被目擊到了，
但還有另一個重要原因。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Satan Morocc's power has been causing unnatural gaps in our time-space continuum. The gaps are isolated to this area for now, but we can't be sure if they'll spread.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
魔王夢羅克的力量正在我們的時空連續體中造成不自然的裂隙。
目前這些裂隙僅限於該區域，但我們無法確定它們是否會擴散。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Due to the time-space gaps, Sograt Desert's terrain has changed, and some parts of the desert have disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
由於時空裂隙，蘇克拉特沙漠的地形發生了變化，
沙漠的部分割槽域已經消失。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Furthermore, the situation's gotten worse since Satan Morocc's doppelgangers started appearing, and other monsters have become influenced by its power.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
此外，自從魔王夢羅克的分身開始出現以來，情況變得更加糟糕，
其他魔物也受到了其力量的影響。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
That's all we know so far. If you go out, you'll see what I mean... You may even see horrors that we haven't discovered yet. If you need more information, please speak to the Continental Official.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
目前我們只知道這些。
如果你出去看看，就會明白我的意思...
你甚至可能看到我們尚未發現的恐怖景象。
如果你需要更多資訊，請去對話大陸官員。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Please do your best to hold back Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands. Dismissed.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
請盡力阻止魔王夢羅克。
別忘了，大陸的未來掌握在我們手中。解散。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I see. Keep up your good work in fighting Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
明白了。繼續在對魔王夢羅克的戰鬥中保持出色的表現。
別忘了，大陸的未來掌握在我們手中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Wah... What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
哇... 什麼？你真的擊敗了魔王夢羅克？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
How? Do you have any proof of your victory?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
怎麼做到的？你有勝利的證據嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
...No, I can't just accept and trust your verbal account. I mean, if you've completed such an important mission, you must bring me some evidence.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
...不，我不能僅憑你的口頭陳述就接受並相信。
我是說，如果你完成了如此重要的任務，必須給我一些證據。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Go back, bring proof of your victory, and then come back.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
回去，帶上你勝利的證據，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
什麼？你真的擊敗了魔王夢羅克？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
How? Do you have any proof of your victory?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
怎麼做到的？你有勝利的證據嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Is... Isn't this?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
這...這不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Wow... I think this is really the skin of Satan Morocc. Congratulations, soldier. You just saved this world and people from being consumed by destruction and evil.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
哇...我想這確實是魔王夢羅克的皮。
恭喜你，士兵。你剛剛拯救了這個世界和人民，使他們免於被毀滅和邪惡吞噬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I guess you seriously wounded Satan Morocc, and it retreated to a time-space gap. No doubt it's trying to recoup its strength.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
看來你嚴重擊傷了魔王夢羅克，它撤退到了時空裂隙中。
毫無疑問，它正在試圖恢復力量。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
My only regret is that we can't pursue Morocc beyond this dimension. I'm glad, however, that you defeated Satan Morocc and kept it from regaining its full strength. For now, anyway...
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我唯一的遺憾是我們無法跨越這個維度去追擊夢羅克。
不過，我很高興你擊敗了魔王夢羅克，阻止了它恢復全部力量。至少暫時是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Our researchers might be able to learn some important new facts from this piece of skin... We need to learn all we can about that monster if peace is to be possible in our world's future.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我們的研究員或許能從這塊皮上了解到一些重要的新事實...
如果我們要在未來實現和平，就必須儘可能多地瞭解那個魔物。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Once again, I thank you for your distinguished service on behalf of the Continental Guard and the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. I'll report your great achievement to His Majesty right away.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
再次感謝你在大陸衛兵和盧恩·米德加茲王國服役期間的傑出表現。
我會立刻向陛下彙報你的偉大成就。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I've prepared a few things to give as a reward for you. Let's see... I have three items. Which one do you like to receive?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我準備了一些東西作為給你的獎勵。
讓我看看...我有三件物品。你想領取哪一件？

scripts.text: 1. Seal of Continental Guard
scripts.translation: 1. 皇家衛士的徽章

scripts.text: 2. Morocc Charm Stone
scripts.translation: 2. 夢羅克護符石

scripts.text: 3. Morocc Ring
scripts.translation: 3. 夢羅克戒指

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The Seal of Continental Guard is an extremely valuable reward given directly from the kingdom court. It is a symbol of strength.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
皇家衛士的徽章是由王國宮廷直接頒發的極其珍貴的獎勵。
它是力量的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The accessory's options are: ^0000FF MHP+50, +3% Attack Speed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
該飾品的選項是：^0000FF MHP+50, +3% 攻擊速度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Do you really want the Seal of Continental Guard?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
你確定要領取皇家衛士的徽章嗎？

scripts.text: 1. Yes.
2. No.

[Chief Balrog]
Great, then I'll reward you with the Seal of Continental Guard. Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
很好，那麼我將把皇家衛士的徽章作為獎勵給你。
恭喜你。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I hope you keep in mind that our battle is far from over. Our enemy is the king of demons... I fear that Satan Morocc will return someday soon.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我希望你記住，我們的戰鬥還遠未結束。
我們的敵人是惡魔之王...我擔心魔王夢羅克很快就會捲土重來。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Enjoy your victory, but be ever watchful and vigilant. I will always be here to help and reward you for your service.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
享受你的勝利吧，但請時刻保持警惕。
我會一直在這裡，為你的服務提供幫助和獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You should go rest now. Don't worry, we'll take care of everything else here.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
你現在應該去休息了。
別擔心，這裡的一切我們會處理好的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
No problem. Take your time to think, and then speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
沒問題。請慢慢考慮，然後再來與我對話。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The Morocc Charm Stone is an extremely valuable reward given directly from the kingdom court, and it is a symbol of prosperity and mana.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
夢羅克護符石是王國宮廷直接頒發的極珍貴獎勵，它象徵著繁榮與魔力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The accessory's options are: ^0000FF MSP+50, -1% Casting Speed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
該飾品的選項為：^0000FF MSP+50，施法速度-1%^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Do you really want a Morocc Charm Stone?
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
您確定想要夢羅克護符石嗎？

scripts.text: 1. Yes.
2. No.

[Chief Balrog]
Great, then I'll reward you with a Morocc Charm Stone. Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
很好，那麼我將把夢羅克護符石作為獎勵給你。
恭喜你。

[Chief Balrog]
I hope you keep in mind that our battle is far from over. Our enemy is the king of demons... I fear that Satan Morocc will return someday soon.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
我希望你記住，我們的戰鬥還遠未結束。
我們的敵人是惡魔之王...我擔心魔王夢羅克很快就會捲土重來。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Enjoy your victory, but be ever watchful and vigilant. I will always be here to help and reward you for your service.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
享受你的勝利吧，但請時刻保持警惕。
我會一直在這裡，為你的服務提供幫助和獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You should go rest now. Don't worry, we'll take care of everything else here.
scripts.translation:
[首領 巴洛格]
你現在應該去休息了。
別擔心，這裡的一切我們會處理好的。

[{0}]
Are you talking to yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在自言自語嗎？

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
Wah! Oh, my god, you must be a messenger of the devil trying to interrupt me from feeling Mammi!
I'm not afraid of you, so bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[摸書的男子]
哇！天哪，你一定是惡魔派來的信使，想打斷我感受媽媽的存在！
我才不怕你呢，放馬過來吧！

scripts.text:
^660000Surprised by your voice, he yelled at you, which seemed bizarre.
You wonder what he meant by feeling her when he was just watching and touching a book.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000他被你的聲音嚇了一跳，衝你大喊大叫，看起來有些奇怪。
你想知道他剛才只是看著書、摸著書，為什麼說要“感受”她。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who's Mammi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
媽媽是誰？

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
What? Don't you know Mammi, one of the three greatest Rune-Midgarts' idols?
scripts.translation:
[摸書的男子]
什麼？你不知道媽媽嗎？她是盧恩·米德加茲三大偶像之一啊！

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
Man, you don't know anything, do you?! Well, judging by the stupid look on your face, I guess you're an adventurer running around on meaningless errands for others. Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[摸書的男子]
天哪，你什麼都不知道是吧？！看你這副蠢樣，我猜你就是個替別人跑腿、做無意義差事的冒險者吧。嘿嘿！

scripts.text: ^660000Umm... You now regret speaking to him in the first place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000嗯……你現在後悔剛才跟他搭話了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
My Mammi is different from those other celebrities that only rely on their beauty and lack any real substance.
She always carries books with her despite her hectic schedule. That alone should tell you that she's more intelligent than all the others! Ah... Mammi...
scripts.translation:
[摸書的男子]
我的媽媽和其他那些只靠美貌、毫無內涵的名人不同。
儘管行程繁忙，她總是隨身攜帶書籍。光這一點就足以證明她比其他人聰明多了！啊……媽媽……

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
She even mentioned in an interview in 'Morocc Times' that she wants to meet a man that loves books.
scripts.translation:
[摸書的男子]
她甚至在《夢羅克時報》的採訪中說，想見一個愛書的人。

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
That means... She's waiting for someone like me. Hehehe!
You see, every book in Rune-Midgarts' Library has the name Benjamin written on them... That's me!
scripts.translation:
[摸書的男子]
也就是說……她在等像我這樣的人。嘿嘿嘿！
你看，盧恩·米德加茲圖書館裡的每本書上都寫著本傑明的名字……那就是我！

scripts.text: ^660000This Benjamin seems to be a huge fan of a female celebrity called Mammi. He didn't shut his mouth and worshipped her beauty for a while, but then he suddenly stopped and looked depressed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這個本傑明顯然是女性名人“媽媽”的超級粉絲。他滔滔不絕地讚美了她的美貌，過了一會兒突然停了下來，神情變得沮喪。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
I have a problem....
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
我有個問題……

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
My Mammi said that she's fallen in love with a book written by ^FF0000'Oliver Hilpert'^000000 of Schwarzwald: ^FF0000'The Crow of the Fate,'^000000 but I didn't have a chance of even looking at it!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
我的媽媽說，她愛上了修瓦魯茲巴魯德的^FF0000奧利弗·希爾佩特^000000寫的^FF0000《命運之鴉》^000000，但我連看一眼的機會都沒有！

scripts.text: ^660000The Crow of the Fate^000000?

[Benjamin]
Unless you're blind, you know how terrible Morocc is nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
除非你是瞎子，否則你知道現在的夢羅克有多糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
I really need to read that book and tell her that I'm here for her, but I don't even have the time to regain my breath because of this situation in our hands!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
我真的必須讀那本書，告訴她我就在她身邊，但眼下的局勢讓我連喘口氣的時間都沒有！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
My Mammi pillow cover is buried under debris... Gasp!
Mammi, I'm coming! Don't you die yet!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
媽媽的枕套被埋在瓦礫下面……喘不過氣來了！
媽媽，我來了！求求你，別死掉！

scripts.text: ^660000He seems to see an image of Mammi, and he shouted her name, gasping with anxiety. You feel so sorry for his agony.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他似乎看到了媽媽的幻象，焦慮地喘息著，大聲呼喚著她的名字。你為他的痛苦感到十分難過。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000He inhaled deeply, and then suddenly turned his head toward you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他深吸了一口氣，然後突然轉過頭看向了你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
....Ye... Yes, you!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
……你……是的，就是你！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
You look bored. You must be waiting for someone to give you something to do!
Help me connect with Mammi. Who knows? I may let you have a conversation with Mammi, whom everyone in Rune-Midgarts adores.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
你看起來很無聊。一定是在等有人給你派活吧！
幫我聯絡一下媽媽。說不定……我會讓你和媽媽聊聊天，你知道的，盧恩·米德加茲所有人都愛慕她。

scripts.text: ^660000Didn't you just call me an adventurer that runs around on meaningless errands for others...?^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你剛才不是還說我是一個到處幫人跑腿做無意義雜事的冒險者嗎……？^000000

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
All I'm asking is to check out a book from Prontera Library for me. It sounds easy, doesn't it?
Well, you don't look like someone who loves reading, but I hope you at least know how to check out a book from a library.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
我只是想讓你去普隆德拉圖書館幫我借一本書。聽起來很簡單，對吧？
雖然你看起來不像個愛讀書的人，但我希望你至少知道怎麼從圖書館借書。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
If you help me, I'll show you a limited picture book edition of Mammi... Once. Hehehehe.
What do you say? You do want to help me, right?
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
如果你幫我的話，我就給你看媽媽的限量版寫真集……只看一次哦。嘿嘿嘿嘿。
怎麼樣？你肯定想幫我的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
If you help me, I'll show you a limited picture book edition of Mammi... Once. Hehehehe.
So, aren't you interested in looking at another girl's pictures? Umm, if you want, I can introduce you to a handsome guard in Morocc...
What do you say? You do want to help me, right?
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
如果你幫我的話，我就給你看媽媽的限量版寫真集……只看一次哦。嘿嘿嘿嘿。
所以，你對看別的女生的照片不感興趣嗎？嗯，如果你願意的話，我也可以介紹你認識夢羅克的一位英俊衛兵……
怎麼樣？你肯定想幫我的，對吧？

scripts.text: ^660000What do you want to do?^000000
Help him
scripts.translation: 幫助他

scripts.text: Don't help him
scripts.translation: 不幫他

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Wow, are you really going to help me?
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
哇，你真的要幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Thank you so much! Then remember this title: 'The Crow of the Fate' written by 'Oliver Hilpert.' I'm sure you can find it in Prontera Library.
Hehehe, Mammi! I'm almost there!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
太感謝了！那麼請記住這個書名：奧利弗·希爾佩特寫的《命運之鴉》。我確信你在普隆德拉圖書館能找到它。
嘿嘿嘿，媽媽！我快成功了！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
What, don't you know how to check out a book from a library? Oh, my...
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
什麼，你不知道怎麼從圖書館借書嗎？哎呀……

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oh... Mammi... My Mammi...
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
噢……媽媽……我的媽媽……

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Don't you forget this title: 'The Crow of the Fate' written by 'Oliver Hilpert.' I'm sure you can find it in Prontera Library.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
別忘記這個書名：奧利弗·希爾佩特寫的《命運之鴉》。我確信你在普隆德拉圖書館能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oh... Mammi... My Mammi...
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
噢……媽媽……我的媽媽……

scripts.text: ^660000Just like the last time that you saw him, Bejamin is living in his dreams, rubbing a book on his face.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000就像上次見到他時一樣，本傑明沉浸在他的幻想中，把書貼在臉上摩擦。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You carefully approached him, and then gave him a pat on the shoulder.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你小心翼翼地靠近他，然後拍了拍他的肩膀。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Grrrr! Who dares touch me?!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
嘎吱！誰敢碰我？！

scripts.text: ^660000...Umm... Obviously you weren't careful enough... ^000000

[Benjamin]
Who dares interrupt me from feeling Mammi? Do you want a piece of me... Err?
Gosh, it's you. What took you so long? Wasn't Prontera Library, like, five minutes away?
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
誰敢打斷我和媽媽的親密接觸？你想嚐嚐我的厲害嗎……嗯？
啊，原來是你。怎麼花了這麼久？普隆德拉圖書館離這裡不是隻有五分鐘路程嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahchoo! Thanks to you, I couldn't find it from the library. So I travelled all the way up to Schwarzwald... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿嚏！多虧了你，我在圖書館找不到那本書。所以我一路跑到了修瓦魯茲巴魯德……阿嚏！

scripts.text: ^660000Feeling angry at him, you exaggerated a fit of sneezing which you have had for quite a while.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你對他感到生氣，於是誇張地打了一個你一直有的噴嚏。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oh... you did?
Hehehe, you're more reliable than I thought. Thanks for the book... Wait, does that mean I have to go up to Schwarzwald to return this? Man!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
哦……你做到了？
呵呵呵，你比我想像的更可靠。謝謝你的書……等等，這難道意味著我要去修瓦魯茲巴魯德還書嗎？天哪！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
...No, I can do anything as long as it's for Mammi. Heh heh, you're a kind adventurer. Thanks.
Was it cold up there? I guess it is since Schwarzwald is located up north from here.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
……不，只要是為了媽媽，我什麼都願意做。呵呵，你真是個善良的冒險者。謝謝。
那裡冷嗎？我想應該很冷，因為修瓦魯茲巴魯德位於這裡的北方。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Let me think. If this book is not yet available in Prontera Library, it must mean that not many people of Rune-Midgarts have read this book.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
讓我想想。如果普隆德拉圖書館還沒有這本書，那就意味著盧恩·米德加茲沒多少人讀過這本書。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Grrrr... Mammi! Here I am, following your noble tastes to read such a rare book! Mammi...!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
嘎吱……媽媽！我為了追隨你高貴的品味，竟然去讀這麼稀有的書！媽媽……！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
I feel so excited to think about having a deep conversation with Mammi about literature! Yay!
I should go read this book right away. Hehehe!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
一想到能和媽媽深入探討文學，我就好興奮！耶！
我得馬上去讀這本書。呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oops, I must not forget to repay you. You know, I'm a polite man.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
哎呀，我不能忘記報答你。你知道的，我是個有禮貌的人。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Look, it's the picture book of Mammi I told you about.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
看，這就是我告訴過你的媽媽繪本。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Ah... Look at this picture of her wearing the rolled-up puppy ears! Doesn't she look like a sad puppy wandering Comodo, the City of Lovers, all by herself?!
How could no one shed a tear after watching this sad picture of her?! Argh, Mammi! I'm coming to make you the happiest woman in the world!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
啊……看看這張她戴著卷卷小狗耳朵的照片！她看起來是不是像一隻在克魔島——這座戀人之城——獨自遊蕩的悲傷小狗？！
看完這張悲傷的照片，怎麼會有人不流淚呢？啊，媽媽！我要去讓你成為世界上最幸福的女人！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'She looks different than I thought with these glasses and pony tails... She really looks like someone who loves literature.
Wait, when did people start calling Comodo the City of Lovers? Hmm... This guy really thinks weird things!'
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
‘她戴著這副眼鏡和馬尾辮，看起來和我想像的不太一樣……她真的很像熱愛文學的人。
等等，什麼時候開始有人把克魔島稱為戀人之城了？嗯……這傢伙的想法真奇怪！’

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
I've decided to give you this <Angel Mammi's Special picture book: In Comodo> which is full of her beautiful pictures in return of your favor. Ahem... What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
我決定把這本《天使媽媽的特別繪本：在克魔島》送給你，裡面全是她美麗的照片，作為對你幫助的回報。咳……你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: ^660000He is staring at you arrogantly. Obviously, he doesn't care if you like the book or not.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他傲慢地盯著你。顯然，他並不在乎你是否喜歡這本書。^000000

scripts.text: I'll take it.
scripts.translation: 我收下吧。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: '^660000Well, if it's for free, and there's no harm keeping it.'^000000
scripts.translation: ‘^660000既然是免費的，留著也沒什麼壞處。’^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, thanks. I'm not interested in her as much as you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，謝謝。我對她沒你那麼感興趣。

scripts.text: ...^660000Was what you were about to say, but you could not refuse his offer. Looking at his fanatical eyes, burning with love for her, even Odin could not refuse...^000000
scripts.translation: ……^660000這是你原本想說的話，但你無法拒絕他的提議。看著他眼中燃燒著對她的愛意的狂熱眼神，即使是奧丁也無法拒絕……^000000

scripts.text:
^660000Quickly blinking his eyes, he made you take Mammi's picture book in your arms
demanding that you must encase the book so it would not be damaged.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他眨了眨眼，強行將瑪米的繪本塞進你懷裡，並要求你必須好好保護這本書，絕不能讓它受損。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oh, right. If you're interested in this author, Oliver Hilpert, I suggest you read the prequel of <The Crow of the Fate>, ^3131FF<The Trace of the Fate>^000000 as well as the sequel.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
哦，對了。如果你對這位作者奧利弗·希爾佩特感興趣，我建議你同時也讀一讀《命運之鴉》的前傳^3131FF《命運之痕》^000000以及續集。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
That was also a bestseller.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
那本書也是暢銷書。

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Now I need to start reading this book for the moment that I'll meet my Mammi, so please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
現在我得開始讀這本書了，為了迎接與瑪米見面的那一刻，請讓我一個人靜靜。

scripts.text: ^660000As soon as he finished, he returned to escaping reality by indulging himself in his dreams of Mammi.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000話音剛落，他便沉浸在關於瑪米的幻想中，逃避著現實。^000000

scripts.text:
^660000The Trace of the Fate, huh?
Well, I don't have anything else to do. I might want to read the book...^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000《命運之痕》嗎？
反正我也沒什麼事做。也許我可以去讀讀那本書……^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, does it mean that I have to go back to Juno Library?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，這難道意味著我得回朱諾圖書館嗎？

scripts.text: ^660000Thinking of travelling back to Juno made you sigh in frustration.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000一想到要返回朱諾，你便沮喪地嘆了口氣。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You have embarked on a journey to Juno to read the prequel of <The Crow of the Fate>: <The Trace of the Fate>.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你踏上了前往朱諾的旅程，去閱讀《命運之鴉》的前傳：《命運之痕》。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, Benjamin!
I've got the perfect thing to help you appeal to Mammi. Do you want to see?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，本傑明！
我找到了一個能幫你打動瑪米的完美東西。你想看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
WH... WHAT?!
What is they? Show me!?
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
什...什麼？！
那是什麼？快給我看看！

scripts.text: ^660000You have shown him an autograph and a written note by Oliver Hilpert.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你向他展示了奧利弗·希爾佩特的親筆簽名和留言。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oh, my god!
These will surely help me get closer to Mammi!
Give them to me!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
天哪！
這些肯定能幫我離瑪米更近一步！
快給我！

scripts.text: Give
scripts.translation: 給他

scripts.text: Don't Give
scripts.translation: 不給

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oh, {0}!
You are the best! Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
哦，{0}！
你真是最棒的！謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Maaaammmiii!
I'm going to see her tomorrow as soon as the morning comes! Mammi, I'm coming!
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
瑪...瑪米！
明天一早我就去見她！瑪米，我來了！

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Huh? What, are you kidding me?
scripts.translation:
[本傑明]
哈？什麼，你在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Benjamin]
Oh... Mammi... Oh...

[Benjamin]
Oh... Mammi... Oh...
With dreamy eyes, the man is looking down at a book in his hand.
scripts.translation: 男子眼神迷離，低頭看著手中的書。

scripts.text:
[Curator Guys]
Our library's Monster Encyclopedia has every monster in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom categorized by dungeon, to help our readers find them easily.
We also have many essential books for adventurers. Why don't you take a look?
scripts.translation:
[館長 蓋斯]
我們圖書館的《魔物圖鑑》收錄了盧恩·米德加茲王國所有的魔物，並按地下城分類，方便讀者查詢。
這裡還有許多對冒險者來說必不可少的書籍。要不要去看看？

scripts.text:
[Curator Guys]
The other library across the street also has Monster Encyclopedias.
If you're interested, feel free to drop by that library as well.
scripts.translation:
[館長 蓋斯]
街對面的那家圖書館也有《魔物圖鑑》。
如果您感興趣，也歡迎去那裡看看。

你知道那句老話嗎：“在圖書館工作三年，就能背下《埃達》。”

Renowned Assassin Sieglinde: 'I serve you only.'
 
 Sieglinde has attained the title of Greatest Assassin
for his professionalism
and fame among ladies,
for his bad-boy image characterized by his sharpened Katar:
a handsome man that lives a life of romantic loneliness.
Recently this Assassin-Turned-Into-Celebrity has made
a true confession with a smile on his face:
he has been secretly going out with a lady,
and they are planning to wed next year.
 The lady in question is known as Priestess M,
and she works in Prontera Church, but he refused to give us more information
about his fiancee for the sake of her safety.
As soon as the news spread,
his female fans showed a negative reaction
saying, 'This is ridiculous.
Assassins must live alone under the shadows.'
Hopefully the fans' reaction won't cause too much worry
to Siglinde and his soon-to-be wife.
scripts.translation:
- 第1頁 -
著名刺客西格琳德：“我只為您效勞。”

西格琳德憑藉其專業素養，
以及在女士們中的名聲，
還有那標誌性的壞男孩形象——
手持磨得鋒利的拳刃，
過著浪漫而孤獨生活的英俊男子——
獲得了“最強刺客”的稱號。
最近，這位從刺客轉型為明星的人物，
面帶微笑地做出了真正的告白：
他一直在秘密地與一位女士約會，
並計劃明年結婚。
這位女士被稱為女祭司M，
在普隆德拉教堂工作，
但為了她的安全，他拒絕透露更多關於未婚妻的資訊。
訊息傳出後，
他的女性粉絲反應強烈，
表示：“這太荒謬了。
刺客必須獨自生活在陰影之下。”
希望粉絲們的反應不會給西格琳德
和他的準新娘帶來太多擔憂。

scripts.text:
- Page 4 -
Fight Scene in Juno
 
Last night, two young men were witnessed
violently fighting each other in Juno Plaza.
According to the Juno soldier that arrested them,
Mr. B had not been so happy with Mr. A's
careless behavior, and it seems
that his patience finally ran out last night.
It seems the fight started when Mr. A put his bare sweaty feet on Mr. B's thigh,
saying that his feet are too sweaty.'
Blame the hot weather, people!
scripts.translation:
- 第4頁 -
朱諾的打鬥場面

昨晚，兩名年輕男子被目擊
在朱諾廣場激烈互毆。
根據逮捕他們的朱諾士兵的說法，
B先生一直對A先生
漫不經心的行為感到不滿，
看來他的耐心昨晚終於耗盡了。
似乎這場架是因為A先生
把光著腳、滿是汗水的腳踩在B先生的大腿上，
並說他的腳太臭而引發的。
“怪天氣太熱了，人們！”

scripts.text:
God's Warning: A Secret Lab Reduced to Ashes
 
 The smoke clouding the sky of Juno last night
turned out to be from
a secret laboratory set on fire.
 More information about the laboratory
has not yet been released, but according to the witnesses,
the laboratory was found empty
without anybody or anything inside
except broken pieces of test tubes
which proved that the place was used as a laboratory.
 Scientist Sion, the accident scene investigator,
suspects from the remnants of machines inside
that the laboratory must have been used
to test biotechnology projects,
and expressed his belief that the fire was the wrath of God,
righteous punishment for trifling with his creations.
scripts.translation:
神的警告：秘密實驗室化為灰燼

昨晚籠罩朱諾天空的煙霧，
原來是一座秘密實驗室起火所致。
關於該實驗室的更多資訊
尚未公佈，但據目擊者稱，
實驗室被發現時裡面空無一人，
除了破碎的試管碎片，
這些碎片證明該處曾被用作實驗室。
事故現場調查員、科學家西昂，
根據室內機器殘骸推測，
該實驗室可能用於測試生命工學研究專案，
並堅信這場火災是神的憤怒，
是對褻瀆神造物者的公正懲罰。

'Please Save My Water' is about a girl called Ujer
who was blessed by Mother Nature.

and she is fighting against a group of evil villains
that are contaminating nature so that she can purify the water.
This book will be soon selected as an essential academic book of

《請拯救我的水》
在圖書館借閱率中名列前茅。

她受到了自然母親的祝福。
她的父親在臨終前立下遺囑，
要求她“保護水源”免受邪惡侵害，
她正在與一群汙染自然、
企圖讓她淨化水源的邪惡反派鬥爭。
這本書很快將被選為
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的必修學術書籍，
以促進道德修養
和全國範圍內的環境保護。

scripts.text:
< Since he was young - it was before he could even remember exactly how young he was - his dreams have filled his brain with immense knowledge that he had never seen or learned from anywhere else.
He was a little boy outside, but wiser than any grown sage. He spoke many languages so fluently that they sounded like Edda chanted by Odin.
To him, his small and dark underground village was a prison blocking him from satisfying his curiosity and desire for freedom.
He expressed his desire to learn more knowledge of the outside world to stepmother Eva, but she always ignored his wish with a stern look.
Eventually, her unreasonable dissuasion could no longer stop him from escaping his reality.
 
- Gasp! Gasp! -
He ran through the darkness which seemed to have no end. He was running away from everything that tried to confine him.>
scripts.translation:
< 從他年幼時起——甚至早到他無法確切記得自己有多小的時候——他的夢境就填滿了他的大腦，賦予了他從未在任何地方見過或學過的淵博知識。
他在外面是個小男孩，卻比任何成年的賢者都要睿智。他流利地掌握了許多語言，聽起來就像奧丁吟唱的埃達一樣。
對他來說，那個狹小陰暗的地下村莊是一座監獄，阻礙了他滿足好奇心和追求自由的渴望。
他向繼母伊娃表達了自己想要學習更多關於外部世界知識的願望，但她總是用嚴厲的眼神無視他的請求。
最終，她不合理的勸阻再也無法阻止他逃離現實。
 
- 喘氣！喘氣！ -
他在看似沒有盡頭的黑暗中奔跑。他在逃離一切試圖禁錮他的東西。>

scripts.text:
< - Umm...-
-...He's awake.-
- Hello, can you see me? How do you feel? -
An old man slowly walked into the room. With a smile on the face, he sat down on a chair. The little boy felt afraid for a little while after seeing people outside his village for the first time,
but then he forced himself up from the bed, and looked around.
 
- Where am I? Why am I here? - 
- I was riding a carriage last night, and found you lying in the street. My name is Haeji. You may call me Mr. Haeji, son.-
-.......-
- What's your name? -
-......Al.-
- Do you know why you're on the street? Where do you live? Your parents must be dying to see you.-
Haeji's comment instantly brought the monsterous image of Eva to Al's mind. Inwardly, he screamed in fear.
- I live nowhere, and I don't have parents. -
Al had to lie no matter how long, he thought. The old man seemed to understand him: his eyes showed sympathy for the little boy. Haeji insisted that Al could stay in his mansion as long as he wanted.
Later, after learning that Haeji was a professor of Juno City University, Al was convinced that the fates were on his side.>
scripts.translation:
< - 嗯...-
-...他醒了。-
- 你好，你能看見我嗎？你感覺怎麼樣？ -
一位老人慢慢走進房間。他面帶微笑，在椅子上坐下。小男孩第一次看到村外的人，感到有些害怕，
但隨後他強迫自己從床上坐起來，環顧四周。
 
- 我在哪裡？我為什麼在這裡？ - 
- 昨晚我坐馬車時，發現你躺在街上。我叫海吉。你可以叫我海吉先生，孩子。-
-.......-
- 你叫什麼名字？ -
-......阿爾。-
- 你知道自己為什麼會在街上嗎？你住在哪裡？你的父母一定很想見你。-
海吉的話立刻讓阿爾腦海中浮現出伊娃那怪物的形象。他在內心恐懼地尖叫。
- 我沒有家，也沒有父母。 -
無論多久，阿爾都不得不撒謊。老人似乎理解了他：他的眼神流露出對小男孩的同情。海吉堅持讓阿爾可以一直住在他的大宅裡。
後來，在得知海吉是朱諾城大學的智者後，阿爾確信命運站在自己這一邊。>
