but it is more shocking that God has given such a rare picture book of her
to someone like you who does not appreciate its value!
I flew over to the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom on the earliest airship
to get this book on the day it was released, but the books were sold out. The person right in front of me got the last one!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
什麼？我現在很震驚！
看到你竟然對瑪米女士的美貌無動於衷，這很令人震驚，
但更令人震驚的是，上帝竟然把這麼稀有的畫冊送給了一個不珍惜它價值的人！
我坐最早一班飛空艇趕到盧恩·米德加茲王國，想在發售當天買到這本書，但書已經賣光了。排在我前面的人買走了最後一本！

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
Umm...
If you don't really like that book, why don't you sell it to me?
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
嗯...
如果你真的不喜歡那本書，為什麼不賣給我呢？

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
As I told you earlier, it's something I'm willing to cross continents to get. Please?
I really want to buy your book!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
正如我之前所說，這是我願意跨越大陸也要得到的東西。拜託了？
我真的非常想買下你的書！

scripts.text: Sell
scripts.translation: 出售

scripts.text: Don't Sell
scripts.translation: 不賣

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
Wow, thanks!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
哇，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
Umm... I haven't received my publishing advance yet, but do you mind taking this instead?
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
嗯...我還沒收到出版預付款，你介意先收下這個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
Okay... I see...
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
好的...我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
I haven't had a chance to open it, but my publisher said it has something very rare inside. I hope that it's enough to pay you for your book.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
我還沒機會開啟它，但我的出版商說裡面有很稀有的東西。希望這足夠支付你那本書的費用。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haha, thanks.
You know, in Morocc... Ahchoo! ...There's someone who's as big a fan of Mammi's as you... Ahchoo! So why don't you go meet him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈，謝謝。
你知道嗎，在莫洛奇...阿嚏！...那裡有一個和你一樣喜歡瑪米的人...阿嚏！所以你們為什麼不去見見他呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got that book from him as a gift. He may have more rare books of her... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那本書是他送給我的禮物。他可能還有更多她的稀有書籍...阿嚏！

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
Oh, thank you so much for such valuable information!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
哦，非常感謝你提供這麼寶貴的資訊！

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
Wah! I must write down the story that I saw in my dream last night before I forget!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
哇！我必須把昨晚夢裡看到的景象寫下來，不然就要忘了！

scripts.text:
[Oliver Hilpert]
I hope you'll also like my next book. Then I must go... Thank you for the picture book!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗·希爾佩特]
希望你會喜歡我的下一本書。我得走了... 謝謝你的繪本！

scripts.text:
^660000He started running around like a chicken with its head cut off. He quickly opened his bag, took out his notebook, ran to a table, and then started writing down something at a fast speed.
At first, he looked pretty silly, but now he strikes you as a man that's very serious about his writing.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000他像只無頭小雞一樣到處亂跑。他迅速開啟背包，掏出筆記本，跑到一張桌子前，然後開始飛快地寫些什麼。
起初，他看起來有點傻，但現在你發現他是個對寫作非常認真的人。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You were about to leave when you found a piece of paper on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你正要離開時，發現地上有一張紙。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000The piece of paper is covered with scribbles, and is labeled <The Crow of the Fate> at the top. Oliver must have dropped this note containing information about his novel, <The Crow of the Fate>.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那張紙上寫滿了塗鴉，頂部寫著<命運之鴉>。奧利弗一定是掉了這張包含他小說<命運之鴉>資訊的紙條。^000000

scripts.text:
^3131FFAncient weapon = Some kind of power source^000000
^3131FFSeclusion - A female disciple's letter^000000
^3131FFThe stepmother = Lover from a past life?!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF古代武器 = 某種能量源^000000
^3131FF隱居 - 女弟子的信件^000000
^3131FF繼母 = 前世的情人？！^000000

scripts.text: ^660000The book's cover was seriously damaged, considering its recent publishing date. Many people must have turned its pages.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000考慮到這本書的出版日期很近，它的封面卻破損得相當嚴重。一定有很多人翻閱過它。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
Waaaaah!
scripts.translation:
[???]
哇啊啊啊！

scripts.text: ^660000Startled by a terrifying scream, you regained consciousness. It seems that you were lost in time for quite a while.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000被一聲恐怖的尖叫驚醒，你恢復了意識。看來你在時間中迷失了相當長一段時間。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You scrambled to stand on you feet, and then followed the sound of the scream to an old and abandoned building.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你慌忙站起身，循著尖叫聲來到一座古老廢棄的建築前。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000The old, huge and somehow intimidating building was expelling dark red smoke out of broken and open windows.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這座古老、巨大且透著幾分壓迫感的建築，正從破碎敞開的窗戶中冒出暗紅色的煙霧。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000While trying to remember what happened, you encounter a woman who passes by you. You instinctively reach for her shoulder to get her attention.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000當你試圖回憶剛才發生了什麼時，一位女子從你身邊經過。你本能地伸手抓住她的肩膀，試圖引起她的注意。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahchoo! Ahchoo! Gosh...
Hey, where am I...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿嚏！阿嚏！天哪...
嘿，我在哪裡...？

scripts.text: - Pzzzz -
scripts.translation: - 滋滋滋 -

scripts.text: ^660000Surprisingly, your arm passed through her body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000令人驚訝的是，你的手臂直接穿過了她的身體。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Where the hell am I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我到底在鬼地方？

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Fire!
Everybody, move, move!
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
著火了！
大家，快跑，快跑！

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Cough, cough!
Argh... I can't breathe... I have to get out...
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
咳咳！
啊...我喘不過氣...我必須逃出去...

scripts.text: ^660000You walked through the flame engulfed hallway and ended at a room that was about to collapse, just like everywhere else in this place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你穿過被火焰吞噬的走廊，來到一間即將坍塌的房間，就像這裡其他地方一樣。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You could not clearly see what was inside the room because of all the smoke, but you knew there was something there.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000由於煙霧瀰漫，你看不清房間裡的情況，但你知道那裡有東西。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You squinted your eyes, and listened. You could hear human voices, but their silhouettes of whomever was talking were not human shaped.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你眯起眼睛，仔細聆聽。你能聽到人聲，但說話者的輪廓並非人形。^000000

scripts.text:
[Female]
Cough! Fire... Cough!
Goddamn humans... Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[女性]
咳！火...咳！
該死的人類...咳咳！

scripts.text: ^660000Her coughing grew worse as the roaring of the flames grew stronger.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000隨著火焰的咆哮聲愈發強烈，她的咳嗽也愈發劇烈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Male]
They ran away, and left us behind to die!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
他們逃走了，卻把我們留在這裡等死！

scripts.text:
[Female]
...Are we going to die?
scripts.translation:
[女性]
...我們要死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Male]
Die? ...Haha.
^3131FF'Eva'^000000, we won't die... We were never exactly alive to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[男性]
死？...哈哈。
^3131FF伊娃^000000，我們不會死的...我們本來就不算活著。

scripts.text: - Crumbling -
scripts.translation: - 崩塌 -

scripts.text:
[Male]
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
啊！

scripts.text: ^660000The only exit was blocked by steel bars; no one could get out of the room enveloped in flames. Then, a corner of a wall crumbled by the heat from the fire.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000唯一的出口被鋼條封死，沒人能逃出這間被火焰包圍的房間。隨後，牆壁的一角因高溫而崩塌。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000The male silhouette quickly approached the wall, and started to dig at the crumbled corner.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那個男性的身影迅速靠近牆壁，開始挖掘崩塌的角落。^000000

scripts.text:
[Male]
...It's done!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
...完成了！

scripts.text:
[Male]
Let's go, Eva!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
走，伊娃！

scripts.text:
[Eva]
Wait, we have to take the children with us.
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
等等，我們要帶上孩子們。

scripts.text: ^660000The female silhouette called Eva approached the test tubes standing in a row against a wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那個被稱為伊娃的女性身影走向靠牆排列的一排試管。^000000

scripts.text:
[Male]
Eva!! We don't have time to save all of them! Come here!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
伊娃！！沒時間救所有人了！快過來！

scripts.text: ^660000Suddenly a flash of light stung your eyes. A few seconds later, you opened your eyes and found that you were somewhere in Schwarzwald.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000突然，一道強光刺痛了你的眼睛。幾秒後，你睜開眼，發現自己身處修瓦魯茲巴魯德。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000And you aren't alone: you can now clearly see the man and woman that escaped the laboratory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000而且你並不孤單：你現在能清楚地看到那對從實驗室逃出來的男女。^000000

scripts.text:
[Grotesque Man]
Where should we go?
No one will welcome us... We look like monsters!
scripts.translation:
[面目猙獰的男子]
我們要去哪裡？
沒人會歡迎我們...我們看起來就像魔物！

scripts.text:
[Eva]
...
I know a cave that's hidden in the north.
We can stay there for a while.
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
...
我知道北邊有個隱蔽的山洞。
我們可以先在那裡待一段時間。

scripts.text: ^660000They seemed completely oblivious of your presence, and headed north.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他們似乎完全沒察覺到你的存在，徑直向北走去。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You were looking at their backs as they left, and then noticed that you were holding the book you were reading in your hands. Then....^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你望著他們離去的背影，然後注意到自己手裡正拿著剛才在讀的那本書。接著....^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You wake up, and look around you. Somehow, you've now ended up in a huge mansion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你醒來，環顧四周。不知為何，你現在身處一座巨大的宅邸中。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You suddenly feel a sharp pain in your chest, as if someone were squeezing your heart.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你突然感到胸口一陣劇痛，彷彿有人正在擠壓你的心臟。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000This mansion looks very elegant and expensive, but it is on fire, just like the laboratory in your first dream.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000這座宅邸看起來非常優雅昂貴，但它正在燃燒，就像你第一個夢中的實驗室一樣。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You're having trouble thinking because of your chest pain and the fire, but you know that this mansion won't last long. You look around for an exit, and see a man standing downstairs in the center of flames.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000胸口的疼痛和火焰讓你難以思考，但你知道這座宅邸撐不了多久。你四處尋找出口，看到樓下火焰中央站著一個男人。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000He didn't seem to care that he'd perish along with the mansion, and was talking slowly in a low, sad voice.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他似乎並不在意自己將與宅邸一同化為灰燼，只是用低沉而悲傷的聲音緩慢地訴說著。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
.....................
After all, God has trifled with me...
This was his plan all long...
Even my best friends were his puppets...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
.....................
到頭來，神一直在戲弄我...
這一切都是他的計劃...
甚至我最親密的朋友也是他的傀儡...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
I strongly resent my fate...
But I'm ready to accept the end... Of everything...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
我強烈地憎恨自己的命運...
但我已準備好接受終結... 一切的終結...

scripts.text: ^660000He could not finish his words before flames swallowed him up. At the same time, you were...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他沒能說完話，就被火焰吞沒了。與此同時，你...^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Was it a dream?
..................
...Gosh, that was strange.

[Mysterious Man]
Mother was... She was a regular human.
Was I standing next to her?
..................
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
母親是... 她只是個普通的人類。
我剛才站在她身邊嗎？
..................

scripts.text: ^660000He mumbled to himself, and brushed back his sweaty hair with a trembling hand.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他喃喃自語，用顫抖的手撥開滿是汗水的頭髮。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A dream again.
I guess he won't be able to see or hear me, just like the others.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
又是夢。
看來他和其他人一樣，既看不見也聽不到我。

scripts.text:
^660000You put your guard down, and stare at him.
Suddenly his face distorted in anger as he looked right back at you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000你放鬆了警惕，凝視著他。
突然，他轉過頭直視著你，臉上露出憤怒的神情。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
How the hell did you find me?!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
你他媽是怎麼找到我的？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Wah! He can see me! He can see me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...哇！他能看到我！他能看到我！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Woman]
You don't have to be so angry at me, sir.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的女子]
先生，您不必對我這麼生氣。

scripts.text:
^660000As soon as you heard her voice,
you turned around and found a woman standing there.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000聽到她的聲音，你轉過身，發現那裡站著一個女人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Woman]
It was almost done, but then you broke all of them -- even ^FF00FFBEEP^000000 and ^FF00FFBEEP^000000 -- and were hiding in here.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的女子]
本來都快完成了，結果你卻把它們全毀了——連^FF00FF嗶嗶^000000和^FF00FF嗶嗶^000000都毀了——還躲在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
They weren't supposed to exist in this world!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
它們本不該存在於這個世界！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Woman]
It's his decision. Your fate is on his...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的女子]
這是他的決定。你的命運掌握在他...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Shut up!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
閉嘴！

scripts.text: ^660000The raging man drew a sword, and pointed it at her. She then suddenly transformed into a crow and flew away. The echos of her laughter could be heard outside the window.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000憤怒的男子拔出了劍，指向她。她突然變成一隻烏鴉飛走了。窗外還能聽到她笑聲的迴響。^000000

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
You are bound to your fate, no matter how hard you try to escape...
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
無論你如何試圖逃避，你都註定要面對自己的命運...

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
外人不得越過此地。

scripts.text: Step back.
scripts.translation: 退後一步

scripts.text: No, listen to me!
scripts.translation: 不，請聽我說！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hah, I knew you would be scared of me!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
哈，我就知道你會怕我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... Ahchoo!
'I'm not like other outsiders... Ahchoo!
I have a goal to achieve in here... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...阿嚏！
我和其他外人不...阿嚏！
我有必須在這裡完成的目標...阿嚏！

scripts.text: ^660000Although you a bit intimidated by this guard, and your sneezing definitely not helping, you continue.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000雖然你被這個守衛的氣勢嚇到了，而且你的噴嚏也幫不上什麼忙，但你還是繼續前行。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm here to find somebody!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是來找人的！

scripts.text: Her name is ^FF0000{0}^000000!

[Cave Settler]
Are you kidding me? If you're looking for a missing child, go to the Juno police station!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你在開玩笑嗎？如果你在找失蹤的孩子，去朱諾警察局！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Did you just say Eva?
Hmm...
Wait here.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你剛才說的是伊娃？
嗯...
在這裡等一下。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hey, Jaeda!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嘿，傑達！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Go upstairs, and tell Eva that she has a visitor.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
上樓去，告訴伊娃有客人來了。

scripts.text: ^660000Surprisingly, he seemed to know who Eva is. You still could not believe that she actually exists! It's all so very strange.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000令人驚訝的是，他似乎認識伊娃。你仍然不敢相信她真的存在！這一切都太奇怪了。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You can feel the excitement and anticipation well within you. Maybe you're coming closer to learning what your dreams really mean.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你能感覺到內心湧起的興奮與期待。也許你正逐漸接近了解你夢境的真正含義。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hmm... Yeah? I see.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嗯...是嗎？我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hey, you can pass. Go upstairs, but you'd better think twice before trying anything funny. Do you understand me?
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嘿，你可以過去了。上樓吧，但最好三思而後行，別耍什麼花樣。聽懂了嗎？

scripts.text:
^660000The stern-looking man examined you, and then stepped to the side, allowing you to pass.
You clenched your fists in nervousness, and then started up the dark stairwell.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000這位神情嚴肅的男子審視了你一番，然後讓開了路，讓你通過。
你緊張地握緊了拳頭，然後開始走上昏暗的樓梯。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
外人不得越過此地。

scripts.text: ^660000His voice is as stern and intimidating as his appearance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的聲音和他的外表一樣，嚴厲而令人畏懼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Do you still have business with Zid?
You'd better finish it quickly because we don't like outsiders running around our village.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你還有事要找齊德嗎？
最好快點辦完，我們不喜歡外人在村子裡亂晃。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
外人不得越過此地。

scripts.text: Step back.
scripts.translation: 退後一步

scripts.text: No, listen to me!
scripts.translation: 不，請聽我說！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hah, I knew you would be scared of me!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
哈，我就知道你會怕我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... Ahchoo!
'I'm not like other outsiders... Ahchoo!
I have a goal to achieve in here... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...阿嚏！
我和其他外人不...阿嚏！
我有必須在這裡完成的目標...阿嚏！

scripts.text: ^660000Although you're a bit intimidated by this guard, and your sneezing definitely not helping, you continue.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000雖然你被這位衛兵嚇得有些緊張，而且不停打噴嚏的狀況也沒幫你加分，但你還是繼續向前。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm here to find somebody!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是來找人的！

scripts.text: Her name is ^FF0000{0}^000000!

[Cave Settler]
Are you kidding me? If you're looking for a missing child, go to the Juno police station!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你在開玩笑嗎？如果你在找失蹤的孩子，去朱諾警察局！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Did you just say Eva?
Hmm...
Wait here.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你剛才說的是伊娃？
嗯...
在這裡等一下。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hey, Jaeda!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嘿，傑達！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Go upstairs, and tell Eva that she has a visitor.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
上樓去，告訴伊娃有客人來了。

scripts.text: ^660000Surprisingly, he seemed to know who Eva is. You still could not believe that she actually exists! It's all so very strange.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000令人驚訝的是，他似乎認識伊娃。你仍然不敢相信她真的存在！這一切都太奇怪了。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You can feel the excitement and anticipation well within you. Maybe you're coming closer to learning what your dreams really mean.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你能感覺到內心湧起的興奮與期待。也許你正逐漸接近了解你夢境的真正含義。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hmm... Yeah? I see.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嗯...是嗎？我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hey, you can pass. Go upstairs, but you'd better think twice before trying anything funny. Do you understand me?
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嘿，你可以過去了。上樓吧，但最好三思而後行，別耍什麼花樣。聽懂了嗎？

scripts.text:
^660000The stern-looking man examined you, and then stepped to the side, allowing you to pass.
You clenched your fists in nervousness, and then started up the dark stairwell.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000這位神情嚴肅的男子審視了你一番，然後讓開了路，讓你通過。
你緊張地握緊了拳頭，然後開始走上昏暗的樓梯。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
外人不得越過此地。

scripts.text: ^660000His voice is as stern and intimidating as his appearance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的聲音和他的外表一樣，嚴厲而令人畏懼。^000000

scripts.text:
^660000You are looking at a man who appears as hideous as a monster.
He was the man with Eva that you saw in your dream. Of course, he's older now, and his age is showing in his face and skin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000你正看著一個長相醜陋如魔物的男子。
他正是你在夢中與伊娃在一起時見到的那個人。當然，他現在年紀大了，歲月在他臉上和皮膚上留下了痕跡。^000000

scripts.text: (WHIZZ)

^660000The pain in your chest suddenly hits you...
And your lungs seem much weaker from all of the coughing and sneezing you've suffered lately.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000胸口的疼痛突然襲來...
最近頻繁的咳嗽和打噴嚏讓你的肺部似乎更加虛弱了。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000Rubbing your chest to ease the pain, you keep staring at him in surprise.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你揉著胸口試圖緩解疼痛，驚訝地凝視著他。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000Thankfully, he speaks to you first.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000謝天謝地，他先開口說話了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
Does my appearance bother you?
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
我的長相讓你感到不適嗎？

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
So, you know Eva... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
所以，你認識伊娃...是嗎？

scripts.text: ^660000He sounded weak, as if he did not have enough energy to talk.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的聲音很虛弱，彷彿沒有足夠的精力說話。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... Ahchoo!

[{0}]
Do you know a man by the name of Oliver Hilpert?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你認識一個叫奧利弗·希爾佩特的男人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
Oliver? Well, I don't think so.
What does he have to do with anything?
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
奧利弗？我想我不認識。
他和這件事有什麼關係？

scripts.text: ^660000You have given him Oliver's novel, <The Crow of the Fate>, explaining strange events that have happened to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你把奧利弗的小說《命運之鴉》遞給他，並解釋了最近發生在你身上的奇怪事件。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000He squinted his eyes in curiosity and looked through a few pages of the book quietly. Then he opened his mouth as he handed the book back to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他好奇地眯起眼睛，安靜地翻看了幾頁書。然後他把書遞還給你，張開了嘴。^000000

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
I'm surprised that the story in this book is... It's similar to my life story. Very similar.
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
我很驚訝這本書裡的故事...它很像我的生平。非常像。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
My name is Zid. Tell me what you want from me. I want to know more about this book.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
我叫齊德。告訴我你想要什麼。我想知道更多關於這本書的事。

scripts.text: About the Cave Village
scripts.translation: 關於洞穴村

scripts.text: About Himself
scripts.translation: 關於他自己

scripts.text: About Eva
scripts.translation: 關於伊娃

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Did you notice that our villagers look different?
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
你注意到我們的村民看起來和常人不同嗎？

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Human curiosity has led to great achievements and contributions, but there is a point where knowledge may be too much to handle.
Everyone in this village is a runaway... We are victims of what happens when people play God, seek out forbidden knowledge, and toy with life.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
人類的好奇心帶來了偉大的成就和貢獻，但知識有時也會多到讓人無法承受。
這個村子裡的人都是逃亡者...我們是那些扮演上帝、尋求禁忌知識、玩弄生命的實驗的受害者。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
We have no choice but hide here because they are too powerful for us to speak out against... And we know that isn't right.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
我們別無選擇，只能躲藏在這裡，因為他們太強大，我們無法發聲反抗...但我們知道這是不對的。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I was a normal man once, but poverty made me lose my pride, self-esteem, and identity.
I was sick and tired of worrying about food everyday, and I volunteered to be a test subject in some experiment.
I no longer had to worry about starving, but my life as a 'human' ended that day.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
我曾經是個普通人，但貧窮讓我失去了尊嚴、自尊和身份。
我厭倦了每天為食物發愁，於是自願成為某個實驗的受試者。
我不再需要擔心捱餓，但在那一天，我作為“人類”的生活結束了。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
At first, Eva and I were the only ones here, but others joined us, and we formed a small settlement.
Now I'm the oldest villager, and feel the heavy responsibility of protecting others.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
起初，這裡只有伊娃和我，但後來其他人也加入了我們，我們形成了一個小型定居點。
現在我是村裡最年長的村民，感到保護他人的責任重大。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
The laboratory in which Eva and I were being tested was not ordinary.
It was built to test and duplicate God's power of creation.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
伊娃和我被測試的那個實驗室並不普通。
它是為了測試和複製上帝創造生命的力量而建造的。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
They failed to achieve their objective, and caused a series of unfortunate events
by trying to manipulate materials that were difficult to even examine.
They believed their research would open a whole new world for mankind...
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
他們未能實現目標，並試圖操縱那些連檢查都困難的物質，導致了一系列不幸的事件。
他們相信他們的研究將為人類開啟一個全新的世界...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva was one of them... Although she wasn't kind, she at least sympathized for me because I sold myself out of poverty.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
伊娃是其中之一...雖然她並不善良，但至少因為她同情我因貧窮而出賣自己。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
She had a man who loved her so much...
His name was Sefakiest, and he always supported her research.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
她有一個深愛她的男人...
他的名字是塞法基斯特，他總是支援她的研究。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
He... Killed himself in despair after Eva was turned into a mutant just like me... She wanted him to use her as his test subject.
No one expected him to end his life so easily when he was the most enthusiastic researcher of all.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
他...在絕望中自殺了，因為伊娃像我一樣變成了變異體...她希望他把她當作他的受試者。
沒人預料到他會如此輕易地結束自己的生命，儘管他是所有研究員中最熱情的那一個。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Then somebody set the laboratory on fire. I assume you've seen that in your dream. The fire completely burned down the building.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
然後有人放火燒了實驗室。我想你在夢中見過這一幕。大火將建築物完全燒燬。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva and I were able to escape before we could be found, and then settled down here. After all, we can't just mingle with ordinary humans.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
伊娃和我在被發現之前逃了出來，然後在這裡定居下來。畢竟，我們不能和普通人類混在一起。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva managed to save one of the test subjects which actually grew up into a normal looking human, but he was actually perfect.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
伊娃設法救下了一個受試者，他實際上長成了一個看起來正常的人類，但他其實是完美的。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
That boy ran away when he was about 10. I guess he hit puberty... You know boys and girls at that age.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
那個男孩在10歲左右逃跑了。我想他到了青春期...你知道那個年紀的男孩和女孩。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva couldn't forget him. She was waiting for his return inside this dark cave. For a while, he was sending letters without his address, but then they stopped coming. That's when Eva disappeared.
I found ^3131FFa giant black feather^000000 in her room after she left.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
伊娃無法忘記他。她在這個黑暗的洞穴裡等待他的歸來。有一段時間，他寄來沒有地址的信，但後來信就斷了。就在那時，伊娃消失了。
她離開後，我在她的房間裡發現了一根^3131FF巨大的黑色羽毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I don't know why, but... I believe Eva no longer exists...
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
我不知道為什麼，但...我相信伊娃已經不存在了...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Hmm...
Maybe Oliver is Eva's boy...
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
嗯...
也許奧利弗就是伊娃的那個男孩...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
No, he's too young to be him because it happened a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
不，他太年輕了，不可能是他，因為那已經是很久以前的事了...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I guess it's just an old memory... Why should I care? Why should anyone?
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
我想那只是陳年舊事...我為什麼要在意？誰又會在意呢？

scripts.text: ^660000Zid stopped talking, and then lowered his head. After the pause, he opened his mouth again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000齊德不再說話，低下了頭。沉默片刻後，他再次開口。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Now I'm too old to remember even Eva or the boy.
My purpose in life is to protect the other villagers. They have lives ahead of them, living inside this dark cave.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
我現在太老了，連伊娃和那個男孩都記不清了。
我活著的意義就是保護其他村民。他們還有未來，在這黑暗的洞穴裡生活著。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
The book was interesting, but I'm sure that guy, Oliver, experienced the same thing that happened to you.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
那本書很有趣，但我確信奧利弗那個傢伙，也經歷了和你一樣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Even if he has something to do with Eva, it's too late to do anything for her.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
即使他和伊娃有關，現在想為她做點什麼也來不及了。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Think about it: who can save us from this dark cave, even if Eva or that boy is still alive? The answer is nobody.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
想想看：即使伊娃或那個男孩還活著，誰能把我們救離這個黑暗的洞穴？答案是沒有人。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I'm so sorry for not being much help.
You'd better wake up from the dream, and move on with your life.
...Sadly everything is nothing but a dream...
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
很抱歉，我幫不上什麼忙。
你最好從夢中醒來，繼續你的生活。
...悲傷的是，這一切不過是一場夢...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
If you really feel sorry for us, please do not let others know where we are.
scripts.translation:
[齊德]
如果你真的為我們感到難過，請不要讓其他人知道我們在哪裡。

scripts.text: ^660000Zid turned his head away from you. You're still not sure if all of this is really happening. It's all so surreal...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000齊德把頭扭向一邊。你仍然不確定這一切是否真的發生了。一切都太不真實了...^000000

scripts.text: ^660000Frustrated by the conversation with Zid, you have decided to go back to Morocc and forget everything.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000對與齊德的對話感到沮喪，你決定回到莫洛克，忘掉這一切。^000000

scripts.text:
Zid seemed to have lost his interest in the book.
You have decided to deliver the book to Benjamin of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
齊德似乎對那本書失去了興趣。
你決定把那本書交給莫洛克的本傑明。

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
Don't look at my face...
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
別盯著我的臉看...

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
(Startled)
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
（嚇了一跳）

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Mumble... Mumble...
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
咕噥...咕噥...

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Heh...
You want... This?
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嘿嘿...
你想要...這個嗎？

scripts.text: - She showed you Monster's Feed. -
scripts.translation: - 她給你看了魔物飼料。 -

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Accessory!
My pretty accessory!
Waaah!
My accessory is gone!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
飾品！
我漂亮的飾品！
哇啊！
我的飾品不見了！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
No one in this village welcomes you. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
這個村莊裡沒有人歡迎你。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Your eyes are so tempting... I wanna eat them! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你的眼睛真誘人...我想吃掉它們！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hoho, did he really say that yesterday...?
Wah!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
呵呵，他昨天真的那麼說了嗎...？
哇！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
It's a human...
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
是人類...

scripts.text:
(Whisper)
(Whisper)
scripts.translation:
（低語）
（低語）

Hoho, did he really say that yesterday...?
Wah!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
呵呵，他昨天真的那麼說了嗎...？
哇！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
It's a human...
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
是人類...

(Whisper)
